description: Defines the Toolchain class which manages information about a specific build toolchain, including tools, dependencies, and configuration overrides. It is part of a build system, likely GN (Generate Ninja).

classes.name: Toolchain
classes.description: Represents a build toolchain, managing tools, dependencies, and configuration settings within a build system.

methods.name: GetTool
methods.description: Retrieves a tool by name, returns null if not defined.

methods.name: GetToolAsGeneral
methods.description: Retrieves a tool as a GeneralTool type by name.

methods.name: GetToolAsC
methods.description: Retrieves a tool as a CTool type by name.

methods.name: GetToolAsRust
methods.description: Retrieves a tool as a RustTool type by name.

methods.name: GetToolAsBuiltin
methods.description: Retrieves a tool as a BuiltinTool type by name.

methods.name: SetTool
methods.description: Sets a tool in the toolchain.

methods.name: ToolchainSetupComplete
methods.description: Finalizes setup after all tools are configured.

methods.name: deps
methods.description: Accessors for dependencies that must be resolved before building targets.

methods.name: propagates_configs
methods.description: Get/set whether configs propagate to other target in the toolchain.

methods.name: GetToolForSourceType
methods.description: Returns the tool for compiling a specific source file type.

methods.name: GetToolForTargetFinalOutput
methods.description: Returns the tool that produces the final output for a target.
